projection_method.kind: Nonlinear candidate latitude-registration label on unchanged B16 drawing coordinates
projection_method.lat_formula: candidate_latitude_deg(y,A)=90-180*(y/1200)+A*sin(pi*y/1200), A in (+18,0,-18). This re-labels global candidate screen latitudes, NOT a physically rigid continental translation.
projection_method.longitude: Do not assign any official longitude. x remains B16 working drawing coordinate modulo 2400.
projection_method.interpretation: Relative placement sensitivity within a spherical latitude coordinate system. Coastline polygons and relative geographic anchors do not move; this is not a physically validated equal-area projection.
projection_method.area_weight: Grid cell weight proportional to cos(latitude)*abs(dlatitude/dy) for equirectangular latitude-row reparameterization, avoiding raw pixel counts as land area.
projection_method.raster_rule: 240×120 drawing-grid; land cell centers scanned by polygon crossings, with x +/-2400 wrap for B16 western seam polygon; larger macro polygons take precedence on overlap.
projection_method.climate_interpolation: Linear interpolation between B25 5-degree latitude samples for every land cell; 12 artificial orbital phases; no time/weather data.
projection_method.surface_class: For occupied land: use B25 abstract land endmember; ocean archetype is only a same-latitude comparison, NOT a known real ocean mask or moisture-source solution.

guardrails: All 99 B16 polygons remain candidate noncanonical coastlines; no edits performed to source B16.
Candidate latitude P+ and P- are warped coordinate labels, not continental drifts or geological tectonic reconstructions.
B25 relative solar Q/S0 can be interpolated as an assumed solar geometry index; wind and rainfall are heuristic exploratory scores.
This raster's land cell totals and surface area weights are sampling conventions; neither square kilometers nor official global land coverage.

No particular country's latitude or ocean's official coastline is established: United City/People's Paradise on same supercontinent remains the only relevant canonical relationship, not a dot on the map.
B16 seam crossing is processed with ±2400 periodic copies, avoiding clipped western continent.
A modeled precipitation score does not imply freshwater available to a watershed: slopes, wind direction, orographic rain, currents and evapotranspiration remain unspecified.
No real planet radius/tilt/spin decided; rain indices are not millimeters, temperature anomalies are not degrees Celsius.
Macro regions are anonymous B16 candidate shape IDs; island aggregate is not an officially named archipelago.
next_step: B27 could compare outline preservation and choose a visual candidate projection only after user approval, then test terrain orientation and rain shadow conditions; no immediate canon geography.
